description: Checks candidate notes without creating them. Validates decks, note types, field names, existing media references, empty-card rules, and Anki duplicate rules.

notes.description: Candidate notes to validate without creating them

deckName.description: Full target deck name. Use "::" between parent and child deck names.

mediaReferences.description: References to media files that already exist in Anki; references are safely merged into the selected fields before validation and creation

altText.description: Optional accessible text used only for image references

filename.description: Portable filename inside Anki's flat collection.media folder

modelName.description: Anki note type name. AnkiConnect calls note types "models" in its API.

allowDuplicate.description: Allow Anki to create a duplicate note

checkAllModels.description: Check duplicates across all note types

checkChildren.description: Include child decks in deck-scoped duplicate checking

duplicateScopeDeckName.description: Deck used for duplicate checking when duplicateScope is deck. Defaults to the target deck.

name: validate-note-drafts
title: Validate note drafts
